# <zbk-card>

A composed content surface with optional native link semantics. Card owns
arrangement only: it adds no click handling, selection state, or landmark.

Base class: `.zbk-card`. Variant classes: `.zbk-card--{variant}`. Tokens: `--zbk-card-{property}[-{state}]`. Write `aria-*`/`role` on the element; they relocate to the internal native element. `focus()` forwards to the internal focusable.

## When to use

- A section index, article teaser, or product cell needs one visually bounded content surface.
- Several related content regions need to change orientation and media placement through tokens without changing markup.
- The entire surface has exactly one navigation destination.
- NOT The surface needs several independent links or buttons. → Omit href from the card and place those controls in its content.
- NOT The region only needs visibility control and no card content model. → zbk-panel
- NOT The content is modal or needs focus containment. → zbk-dialog

## Guidance

- Use href only when the whole card has one destination. A linked card cannot contain buttons, links, form fields, or other interactive descendants.
- Do not create a stretched-link overlay. It blocks text selection and hides the real HTML constraint; omit href when the card needs independent actions.
- The title slot takes an author-supplied heading element so the page, not the component, chooses the heading level.
- Use media for a visual block such as an image, video, illustration, or token-driven thumbnail. Use icon only for a supplementary pictogram on components whose contract declares it.
- Card and media radii are independent tokens: flush media can inherit clipping from the card, while inset media can carry its own radius.
- Use auto-orient when orientation should follow the card's own track width. It stacks below container.sm and places media beside the body at or above that threshold.
- auto-orient and horizontal share the layout axis and are alternatives; media-end composes with either.

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `href` | `string \| undefined` | — | Destination. Its presence switches the style root from `<div>` to `<a>`. |
| `target` | `string \| undefined` | — | Native anchor browsing context, forwarded verbatim in linked mode. |
| `rel` | `string \| undefined` | — | Native anchor relationship tokens, forwarded verbatim in linked mode. |
| `download` | `string \| undefined` | — | Native anchor download filename hint, forwarded verbatim in linked mode. |
| `hreflang` | `string \| undefined` | — | Native anchor destination language, forwarded verbatim in linked mode. |
| `type` | `string \| undefined` | — | Native anchor MIME type hint, forwarded verbatim in linked mode. |
| `variant` | `string` | `""` | Space-separated registered variant names, e.g. "ghost lg". Unknown names warn with the registered vocabulary. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| *(default)* | The card's primary body content — any flow markup. | — |
| `media` | The visual block: image, video, svg, canvas, or arbitrary markup. It is not aria-hidden; use the platform alt attribute for images. | — |
| `meta` | Supplementary metadata such as category, byline, date, read time, or tags. | data-position: start\\|end |
| `title` | The card heading. Supply the heading element and level; linked mode uses this region as the accessible name unless the author supplies ARIA naming. | — |
| `footer` | The trailing action or affordance row. | — |

- `meta`: data-position="start" places metadata before the title; data-position="end" places it after body content.
- `meta`: Omitting data-position defaults to end.
- `footer`: In linked mode footer content must be presentational, such as <span aria-hidden="true">Explore →</span>; never nest a link or button.

## Keyboard

- `Tab / Shift+Tab` — Moves focus to and from the card only when href is present (native anchor behavior, preserved).
- `Enter` — Follows the card destination in linked mode (native anchor behavior, preserved).

## Conditions

Conditions are compiled layout branches, not element states. Their suffixed tokens are read only inside the matching at-rule.

| Condition | Kind | Threshold | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `wide` | container | `container.sm` | Card media and body share the inline axis at or above this card width. |

## Events

No custom events. Native events (`click`, `change`, `input`, ...) bubble from the internal native element in light DOM — listen on the zebkit element.

## Examples

**Linked article card**

```html
<zbk-card href="/foundations/color" variant="outlined"><img slot="media" src="/img/color.png" alt="" /><span slot="meta" data-position="start">Foundations</span><h3 slot="title">Color</h3><p>Semantic palettes and contrast pairs.</p><span slot="meta">5 min read</span><span slot="footer" aria-hidden="true">Explore →</span></zbk-card>
```

**Horizontal media at the end**

```html
<zbk-card href="/typography/type-scale" variant="outlined horizontal media-end"><div slot="media" aria-hidden="true">Aa</div><h3 slot="title">Type scale</h3><p>Fluid type sizes and readable measures.</p></zbk-card>
```

**Track-aware orientation**

```html
<div class="grid-fit-20 gap-2"><zbk-card href="/foundations/color" variant="outlined auto-orient"><div slot="media" aria-hidden="true">Color</div><h3 slot="title">Container-aware card</h3><p>The same markup stacks in narrow tracks and becomes horizontal in wide tracks.</p></zbk-card></div>
```

**Inert surface with independent actions**

```html
<zbk-card variant="filled"><h3 slot="title">Workspace</h3><p>Manage members and project access.</p><div slot="footer"><zbk-button>Open</zbk-button><zbk-button variant="outline">Settings</zbk-button></div></zbk-card>
```

Without href the card is a generic container, so independent controls remain valid and keep their native tab stops.

**Text-only card**

```html
<zbk-card variant="plain"><h3 slot="title">Accessibility</h3><p>Contrast, focus, and motion respond through tokens.</p></zbk-card>
```

## Variants

A variant is a named, partial remapping of the token surface compiled to a class. Apply via `variant="name other-name"`; different axes compose, same-axis variants are alternatives.

| Variant | Axis | Class | Description | Overrides |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `auto-orient` (situational) | layout | `zbk-card--auto-orient` | Stacks or goes side by side based on the card's own inline size. | container-type: inline-size; flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; media-flex: 1 1 100%; body-flex: 1 1 100% |
| `elevated` | style | `zbk-card--elevated` | A canvas surface with no border and a shadow that deepens on hover. | box-shadow: {elevation.sm}; box-shadow-hover: {elevation.md}; border-width: 0; canvas: {app.canvas} |
| `filled` | style | `zbk-card--filled` | A muted filled surface with neither border nor elevation. | box-shadow: {elevation.none}; border-width: 0; canvas: {app.canvas-muted} |
| `horizontal` (situational) | layout | `zbk-card--horizontal` | Places media and body side by side with equal flexible shares. | flex-direction: row; media-flex: 1 1 0; body-flex: 1 1 0; media-inline-size: auto; media-block-size: 100% |
| `media-end` (situational) | media-placement | `zbk-card--media-end` | Moves the media region after the body without changing authored order. | media-order: 1 |
| `outlined` | style | `zbk-card--outlined` | A canvas surface bounded by the semantic border with no elevation. | box-shadow: {elevation.none}; border-width: {border.width-sm}; canvas: {app.canvas} |
| `plain` (situational) | style | `zbk-card--plain` | An unframed transparent surface whose body aligns with its media edge. | box-shadow: {elevation.none}; border-width: 0; canvas: transparent; body-padding-inline: 0 |

Custom variants: add a `zbk-card.variants.json` file to the base theme's token folder (component-keyed map of `{ "card": { "{name}": { "overrides": { ... } } } }`; token keys must exist in the table above, values are alias references or structural literals). A shipped variant name patches that variant's CSS — usable immediately. A new name compiles a new `.zbk-card--{name}` class and additionally needs `ZebkitElement.registerVariants(json)` before elements upgrade so `variant="{name}"` validates and applies it.

Related: `<zbk-link>`, `<zbk-panel>`, `<zbk-dialog>`.
